title: Security vulnerability in js-yaml: js-yaml: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources
body:
A security vulnerability was found in module `js-yaml`.

- Vulnerable versions: >=4.0.0 <4.3.2
- Patched versions: >=4.3.2
- Advisory ID: 1193727

Please update the dependency to a patched version.
